author: _Cromwell_
body:
Tier 8 gang here, can confirm this ridiculous shite. 4th month in a row.

This is something that absolutely has no reason to be random. It should rotate through... Weapon, armor, accessory, weapon, armor, accessory, etc.

Better yet just leave accessories out.  70% of them don't benefit from being ornate anyways.

If Odie is trying to make it feel good or compelling to log into this game every day via this calendar, he is failing miserably.
